technology_name: Organo Clay from Waste Mica: A Sustainable Solution for Pollution Control
problem_solved: High-cost & inefficient conventional remediation methods; industrial mica waste disposal; poor sorption capacity of raw mica.
description: Organo clay synthesized by functionalizing waste mica with humic acid, adding carboxyl, hydroxyl, and phenolic groups for chelation, ion exchange, and adsorption of mixed contaminants.
